texte.Unter „Neueste“ blätterst du, unter „Suc: Under “Latest” you browse, under “Search” you write whole sentences, for example “Summer 2022 at the beach”. The filters narrow it down by person, year and country.

texte.Mit „Meine Fotos“ schickst du Fotos von: With “My photos” you send photos from this device. They are saved in Immich and can be mixed with other photos.
texte.Teile Fotos aus der Fotos-App direkt an: Share photos from the Photos app straight to the frame, use Siri (“Show photos on the frame with Showcase Immich”) and the “Picture frame” widget.
texte.Unter „Hilfe“ steht alles Wichtige. Im K: “Help” has everything important. In the account menu “All good?” shows whether Immich and the frames are running.

texte.Was am Rahmen eingeblendet wird und wo:: What is shown on the frame and where: time, today's date, date and place of the photo, weather and appointments. Each element can be switched on or off, moved and resized. Individual frames can have their own arrangement under ⚙.

texte.In der iPhone-App unter „App-Einstellung: In the iPhone app under “App settings” → “Show calendar on the frame” each person shares their appointments. Here you can see who does and remove a phone again.
texte.Ziehe die Elemente in der Vorschau an di: Drag the elements in the preview to the place you want (or choose a position below).

texte.Wetter und Termine auf diesem Rahmen: Weather and appointments on this frame
texte.Ohne eigenen Ort gilt der Standard aus d: Without its own location the default from the settings applies.
texte.Termine von diesen Handys zeigt der Rahm: The frame shows appointments from these phones:
texte.Kalender-Link (iCal) nur für diesen Rahm: Calendar link (iCal) for this frame only
texte.Gelten für Rahmen, die unter ⚙ keinen ei: Apply to frames that have no location or calendar link of their own under ⚙. The arrangement, weather location, calendar link and phones are set for each frame separately under ⚙. For the weather only the place name is sent to open-meteo.com.
texte.In der iPhone-App unter „App-Einstellung: In the iPhone app under “App settings” → “Show my appointments on the frame” each person shares their appointments. Here you can see who does and remove a phone. On which frame a phone's appointments appear is set at the frame under ⚙ (new phones appear on no frame at first).
